note: Core（core-rs/src/tools.rs 的 definitions()）的 LLM 可见工具定义对照表：Rust 侧测试断言本表与 definitions() 逐字段一致（新增 / 改动工具必须同步本表）。

command.description: 要执行的 shell 命令

description.description:
Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. Never use words like "complex" or "risk" in the description - just describe what it does.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:
- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"
- git reset --hard origin/main → "Discard all local changes and match remote main"
- curl -s url | jq '.data[]' → "Fetch JSON from URL and extract data array elements"

cwd.description: 工作目录，默认为当前目录

run_in_background.description: 设置 true 则在后台运行此命令（不会阻塞后续操作）。后台命令完成后会收到通知，无需主动轮询。

detach.description: 仅当命令的进程必须脱离工具管理、在本会话结束后继续运行（如系统级服务）时才设为 true；其余场景不要设置，后台运行请用 run_in_background。

tools.name: Read
tools.description: Reads a file from the local filesystem.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to read

offset.description: The 1-based line number to start reading from (default: 1). 0 is accepted and treated as 1

limit.description: The number of lines to read

sheet.description: Sheet name to read from Excel file. Defaults to the first sheet if not specified.

tools.name: Write
tools.description: Writes content to a file on the local filesystem (creates or overwrites).

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to write

content.description: The content to write to the file

tools.name: Edit
tools.description: Edits a file by replacing exact text matches. Preferred over Write tool for modifying existing files.

file_path.description: The absolute path to the file to edit

new_string.description: The new string to replace it with

replace_all.description: Replace all occurrences within the search range (default: false)

offset.description: The 1-based line number where the search range starts (default: 1)

limit.description: The number of lines to search within. If provided, old_string must match entirely within lines offset to offset+limit-1 (1-based); if omitted, searches to the end of the file

tools.name: Grep
tools.description: Searches for patterns in file contents using ripgrep (rg).

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

path.description: File or directory to search in. Defaults to current working directory

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines, "files_with_matches" shows file paths, "count" shows match counts

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match

context.description: Number of lines to show before and after each match

type.description: File type to search (js, py, rust, go, java, etc.)

head_limit.description: Limit output to first N results. Defaults to 250. Pass 0 for unlimited

offset.description: Skip first N results before applying head_limit. Defaults to 0

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines

tools.name: Glob
tools.description: Finds files by name pattern or wildcard using ripgrep.

pattern.description: The glob pattern to match files against

path.description: The directory to search in. If not specified, the current working directory will be used

tools.name: TodoWrite
tools.description: Create and manage a structured task list to track progress and organize complex work.

tools.name: Agent
tools.description: Create a new sub-agent that runs autonomously in the background.

prompt.description: The task for the agent to perform

description.description: A short (3-5 word) description of the task

agentRole.description: The role of the agent to spawn: Master or Explorer

target.description: Target workspace agent ID (`hostname:path`). Omit to spawn the sub-agent in the current workspace.

tools.name: Reply
tools.description: Send a message to a target session.

message.description: The reply message to send back

targetSessionId.description: Target session ID to send the message to. If omitted, sends to the session that created this agent.

tools.name: Transfer
tools.description: Transfer files or directories between open workspaces, for cross-workspace agent workflows only.

sourcePath.description: Absolute source path on the source workspace's machine

targetPath.description: Absolute target path on the target workspace's machine

sourceTarget.description: Source workspace agent ID (`hostname:path`). Omit for the current conversation's workspace

destTarget.description: Destination workspace agent ID (`hostname:path`). Omit for the current conversation's workspace

tools.name: AskUserQuestion
tools.description: Ask the user one or more questions and wait for their replies.

tools.name: WebSearch
tools.description: Search the web for up-to-date information (DeepSeek Search).

query.description: Search query (1-128 characters). Supports operators like site:, lang:, after:, before: and quoted phrases

count.description: Number of results to return (1-50, default 10)

tools.name: WebFetch
tools.description: Fetch a single web page and return its content as Markdown (DeepSeek Fetch).

url.description: The http(s) url to fetch (no credentials in url)

divergences.reason: TS 的 zodToJsonSchema 对 .default() 字段产出 type=string 且列为必填；Rust 按 zod 声明的 boolean/可选实现。此处豁免类型与必填差异。
